description: List what can be printed: SKUs (storybook books; custom-cut stickers from 1,000 pieces; greeting cards from 10; and, for platforms, sticker-a3 wall charts and greeting-card-a5 folded cards from one copy), formats, supported trim sizes, page-count limits, prices (INR, shipping included; GST included except on stickers, which add 18%), and shipping coverage (India only). Stickers and greeting cards are priced per piece in piece_prices. Call this first to quote a price or check whether a PDF will be accepted.
name: get_catalog
